key_points: Fiber cable cut in New Jersey disrupted backup data feed, causing hundreds of flight delays and a 0.7% pre‑earnings stock dip.
Verizon's free cash flow grew 24.4% YoQ, supporting 2026 growth expectations.
GuruFocus estimates VZ is ~10% overvalued based on dividend and valuation models.
A >$1B fiber deal with Google announced (Sept 20) signals potential revenue upside.
Increasing broadband competition and AT&T valuation debate keep pressure on relative valuation.
